flags.name: ff_content_generation_v1
flags.rationale: Student-facing GenAI Content Generation Agent (Mermaid diagrams, GenAI Phase 5c). CEO-decided FULL rollout at 100% (2026-07-24), SUPERSEDING the earlier staged 10% launch canary — the CEO flipped production to 100% via the super-admin console and directed that full exposure be the committed end state. Verified at the read site: /api/content/diagram re-evaluates the flag with per-user context ({ role, userId }), and isFeatureEnabled applies deterministic per-user rollout via hashForRollout(userId, flagName) < rollout_percentage, so rollout_percentage=100 makes that predicate true for every user, i.e. full exposure to all eligible students. Read-only, NCERT-grounded, fail-soft-to-abstain, student-self-only (P13), bilingual (P7); every generated Mermaid code string still passes the validateMermaidCode injection-safety gate. Not protected / not in EXPECTED_OFF_FLAGS; seeded OFF by 20260724180000, flipped ON at rollout 10 by 20260724210000, and raised to 100 by the later-timestamped superseding migration 20260724220000_set_ff_generation_rollout_100.sql (the merged 10% migration is left intact as history; migrations apply in timestamp order so the later one wins).
flags.enablementEvidence: CEO decision 2026-07-24 to go to 100% (superseding the 10% canary), recorded through the feature-flag governance path (matrix override + regenerate + forward activation migration 20260724220000_set_ff_generation_rollout_100.sql). Production was already at 100% via the super-admin console; this migration makes the committed migration chain converge on the same end state and prevents the unapplied 10% canary migration 20260724210000 from silently downgrading the live flag 100% -> 10% on the next `supabase db push`. Full-exposure rollout verified at the read site apps/host/src/app/api/content/diagram/route.ts (isFeatureEnabled with userId context) -> packages/lib/src/feature-flags.ts (hashForRollout(userId, flagName) < rollout_percentage).
